info.name: Student ID - Server Rules Service
info.description: Authentication: protected Gateway requests inherit Bearer {{accessToken}}. Select a private local Postman environment containing an explicitly disposable, one-hour local test access JWT, using the same Gateway public-key setup as the Player/Session collections. Player has no login, refresh or JWT issuance. Regenerate expired tokens locally; keep tokens and private keys out of tracked files. Gateway removes Authorization before forwarding and does not bind JWT sub to client-provided X-Player-Id; existing service header checks remain unchanged.

variable.description: Disposable local test JWT. Set in a private local environment; keep this collection value empty.
